llm.summary: The skill's files, runtime instructions, and requirements are consistent with a local, offline image-layout tool: it processes local photos with Pillow, writes outputs and a local usage history, and does not request unrelated credentials or network access.

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the local Python script against user photo paths, selecting templates/styles, and using batch/interactive modes. The documented actions (reading photo files, generating preview/full-size images, and writing outputs) match the code. The skill collects optional profile/contact/social fields and stores usage history locally; it does not instruct reading system files or environment variables beyond the photos and working directory.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward, local image-layout tool. Before installing or running: (1) review the scripts/coser_card.py file (you already have it) to confirm no unexpected network calls — the included imports show only local I/O and Pillow; (2) be aware that optional profile/contact/social fields you enter are stored in learning_data.json in the project directory — delete or relocate that file if you don't want history/PII retained; (3) run in an isolated environment (virtualenv) and install only Pillow from PyPI; (4) verify output paths (default ./output/) before running and avoid running the script on system directories.
